description: Make a RUNNING custom app also answer on its sibling name — www.example.com when its domain is example.com, or example.com when it is www.example.com — with a fixed 301 redirect to the main domain that keeps the path and query. The sibling is derived from the app's domain and cannot be chosen; other shapes (app.example.com), platform subdomains and IPs are refused. FIRST the customer creates an A record for the sibling pointing to the server's IP, with no AAAA record: without it nothing is changed and no certificate is requested. Available only when the server's agent supports it; otherwise the answer is 422 (not available for this server yet) and nothing changes. The .onion address is not affected. After a domain change the redirect pauses (status needs_check) until it is turned on again. Read the app (impreza_api_call on /platform/deployments/{id}) for domain_alias.status: pending, active, failed, needs_check or unsupported.

enabled.description: true to serve the sibling and redirect it, false to stop.

name: impreza_set_domain_alias
title: Serve www and redirect
